LitigaForge (India).title: LitigaForge (India)
LitigaForge (India).description: Indian courts and law: eCourts case status, cause lists and orders by CNR; Indian judgments with passages and citing cases (via Indian Kanoon, attributed); citation verification (flags citations it cannot match); IPC→BNS, CrPC→BNSS and Evidence Act→BSA mapping for a whole draft; bare acts; Limitation Act lookup; hearing briefs for the advocate's own tracked cases. Read-only; every result carries source, link and retrieval date.
